title: firemaster crafting tweeks
body:
this is a simple datapack for minecraft 1.21.4, it adds new and balanced crafting recepies to the game so that you can enjoy your game without stressing out on finding a nametag or a saddle. 
**_some recpies like the saddle and nametag are backported from new versions, they might change a bit from the official ones_**

**FUTURE UPDATES**
i'm gonna update the datapack with the suggestion you guys can make, so write me on discord if you have something interesting to add : giorgiofire83_12187.

next update will come out soon and it will add the support to fabric and forge and maybe neoforge 

**this datapack adds crafting recepies for:**
- saddle
- nametag
- tinted glass (new recipe)
- all the horse armours
- gilded black stone
- trident
- bonemeal (using a skeleton skull)

**_wrote on 11/10/25_**
